Macrons

Consonantal i

Theme

Latin word

studium

studium, studiī n.

noun, second declension

pursuit, interest, activity one gives oneself to; eager goodwill, devotion to someone; interest, keenness; a pursuit

In this lexicon

  • activity

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Sen. 76: sunt pueritiae studia certa; Hor. S. 2.1.27–28: quot capitum vīvunt, totidem studiōrum mīlia

  • favour

    also used · classical · Cic. Fam. 5.8.4: eximium et singulāre meum studium (Lewis & Short)

  • interest

    the recommended word · classical · Plin. Ep. 9.33.3: piscandī nāvigandī atque etiam natandī studiō tenētur; Cic. Fin. 5.5; M-O s.v. interest vb.

Examples

  • sunt pueritiae studia certa: num igitur ea dēsīderant adulēscentēs?

    childhood has its own pursuits: do young men miss them, then?Cic. Sen. 76
